  "formattedSource": "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       CLASS CL_SATC_ADT_RES_APP DEFINITION
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
CLASS cl_satc_adt_res_app DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  INHERITING FROM cl_adt_disc_res_app_base
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC .

  PUBLIC SECTION.

    CONSTANTS co_scheme TYPE string VALUE 'http://www.sap.com/adt/categories/atc' ##no_text .

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS:
      get_application_title REDEFINITION,
      register_resources    REDEFINITION.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.                    "CL_SATC_ADT_RES_APP DEFINITION



*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       CLASS CL_SATC_ADT_RES_APP IMPLEMENTATION
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
CLASS cl_satc_adt_res_app IMPLEMENTATION.


  METHOD get_application_title.
    result = 'ABAP Test Cockpit' ##no_text .
  ENDMETHOD.                    "get_application_title


  METHOD register_resources.
    IF ( abap_false EQ cl_satc_permission_control=>is_enabled_in_system( ) OR
         abap_false EQ cl_satc_permission_control=>is_authorized_to_use_ide( ) ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF ( abap_false EQ cl_satc_permission_control=>is_sap_system( ) ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    registry->register_discoverable_resource(
      EXPORTING
        url             = cl_satc_adt_res_atc_run=>co_namespace          "/atc/runs
        handler_class   = cl_satc_adt_res_atc_run=>co_class_name  "CL_SATC_ADT_RES_ATC_RUN
        description     = 'ATC runs' ##no_text
        category_scheme = co_scheme
        category_term   = 'atcruns' ).

    registry->register_resource(
      EXPORTING
        template        = cl_satc_adt_res_verdicts=>co_namespace          "/atc/feeds/verdicts
        handler_class   = cl_satc_adt_res_verdicts=>co_class_name ). "CL_SATC_ADT_RES_VERDICTS

  ENDMETHOD.                    "register_resources
ENDCLASS.                    "CL_SATC_ADT_RES_APP IMPLEMENTATION",
